title: Content Category Record
description: A browsable category node on a website - the shape behind review-page.places.json. Named content_category rather than 'category' to avoid confusion with the envelope's `category` classification field: this is a page that visitors navigate to, not a facet applied to other records. From the original: name -> label, description -> summary, the kebab id -> slug (with a real UUID minted for id), type:'category' -> category.kind, status:'published' -> status:'active', parentIds[0] -> parent_id with any remainder in relations, relationships.related -> relations, media.featuredImage -> attachments. Only the SEO block is genuinely payload.

slug.description: Required here: the slug IS the URL path segment for this category page.

seo.description: Search-engine metadata. Kept in the payload because it is a presentation concern of one website, not a fact about the entity.

title.description: Overrides `label` in the page title tag when set.

keywords.description: Distinct from envelope `tags`: these are phrases aimed at search engines, tags are for your own retrieval. They will often differ in casing and wording.

display.description: Presentation controls for the category page.

sort_order.description: Manual ordering among siblings; lower sorts first.
